events.continuity_hook: Moves the St. Louis seminar from comparison to booking, with only normal pre-trip checks expected afterward.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the St. Louis hotel and flights, choose a Sunday return that leaves enough teardown and airport cushion, and request a window seat if available.
events.scenario_brief: The St. Louis host signs off on the Sunday lab ending at 2:30 p.m. and can receive Kara's demo bag at the medical campus Friday afternoon. The better-rated suite hotel 12 minutes out still has a cancellable queen room with in-room coffee and mini-fridge, plus pool and fitness access but no hot tub; the clinic-attached option remains closer but has weaker recent reviews and only double-bed listings. Sunday return choices now cluster after 6:00 p.m., leaving the decision between commute convenience and a more dependable room setup.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Blue Ridge partner weekend after the first drive-versus-fly comparison, now close enough to reserve the main pieces.
events.interaction_goal: Choose the travel mode, decide between the lodge and downtown base, and book or hold the flight, rental car, and room while key amenities are still available.
events.scenario_brief: The trail organizer opens packet pickup details, and Kara's partner confirms Monday off. Driving the full route from Tampa would absorb too much of Friday and Monday, while flying into a regional airport reduces road time but needs a connection; the larger-airport option is cheaper but adds a long rental-car drive. The mountain-area lodge confirms pool, hot tub, fitness access, and room coffee, but mini-fridges are by request; the downtown inn has stronger walkability but fewer recovery facilities.

events.continuity_hook: Reopens the St. Louis seminar only because transportation timing and arrival logistics changed shortly before travel.
events.interaction_goal: Check the revised arrival timeline, decide whether to keep or change the outbound flight, and list the hotel and campus-arrival details Kara should verify before departure.
events.scenario_brief: A week before St. Louis, the airline moves Kara's Thursday connection later, trimming the buffer before Friday afternoon setup, and the host changes the demo-bag drop-off to a different garage entrance. The suite hotel confirms the queen room, coffee maker, and mini-fridge, but pool hours will be limited during part of the stay because of a youth team block. The unresolved question is whether the later arrival still leaves enough margin or whether to switch to an earlier Thursday routing.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new clinic-training trip after the St. Louis seminar logistics are mostly settled.
events.interaction_goal: Build a practical flight-and-hotel shortlist, compare hospital commute reliability against room basics, and identify what the host must confirm before Kara commits.
events.scenario_brief: A Columbus children's hospital asks Kara to run a Tuesday-Wednesday follow-up coaching visit in mid-August after a remote skills series. She can leave Tampa Monday after a morning class, must be onsite by 7:15 a.m. Tuesday, and wants to avoid a return that wrecks Thursday prep. Flights favor a Monday afternoon outbound with one connection, while hotels split between a campus property with mixed feedback and a better-rated airport-area chain that is easier only if she rents a car.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Columbus clinic-training plan after the debrief time and room availability clarify the main trade-offs.
events.interaction_goal: Pick the safer return plan, choose the hotel that best balances commute and recovery, and proceed with booking if the timing is acceptable.
events.scenario_brief: The Columbus hospital confirms Wednesday debrief will end at 2:45 p.m. and can store demo equipment overnight if a Thursday return becomes necessary. The campus hotel releases a queen room with coffee maker and mini-fridge but no pool or hot tub; the airport-area chain has better ratings, pool and fitness access, and the same room basics, but adds a 25- to 35-minute morning drive. The best Wednesday evening return has a workable but not generous connection, while a Thursday morning nonstop costs more and adds a hotel night.

events.continuity_hook: Reopens the Blue Ridge partner weekend only to protect Friday arrival timing and the Sunday recovery plan.
events.interaction_goal: Verify the arrival buffer, rental-car pickup timing, and lodge amenity notes, then decide whether any travel change is worth making this close to the trip.
events.scenario_brief: Two weeks before the Blue Ridge weekend, packet pickup shifts earlier on Friday and the forecast starts showing a chance of afternoon storms. The booked flight still arrives Friday early afternoon, but a delayed rental-car pickup could make packet timing tight; the lodge confirms the mini-fridge request is noted and hot tub hours start after 6:00 p.m. The remaining decision is whether to keep the regional-airport plan or switch to the larger airport for an earlier arrival with a longer drive.
